nodes.label: S3 Router
nodes.desc: registerAPIRouter (L255) mounts every S3 endpoint; s3APIMiddleware (L210) applies auth and headers; objectAPIHandlers struct at L68.

nodes.label: Object Handlers
nodes.desc: GetObjectHandler (L717), HeadObjectHandler (L1012), CopyObjectHandler (L1157), PutObjectHandler (L1793), DeleteObjectHandler (L2563).

nodes.label: Handler Helpers
nodes.desc: Shared reader/error plumbing between object handlers, including range handling and GetObjectReader wiring.

nodes.label: Multipart Handlers
nodes.desc: HTTP endpoints for NewMultipartUpload, UploadPart, ListParts and CompleteMultipartUpload flows.

nodes.label: Bucket Handlers
nodes.desc: GetBucketLocationHandler (L203), ListBucketsHandler (L305), PutBucketHandler (L720), HeadBucketHandler (L1646), DeleteBucketHandler (L1678).

nodes.label: Notification Handlers
nodes.desc: Configures bucket event notifications; imports internal/event to validate and store SNS target configs.

nodes.label: ObjectLayer Interface
nodes.desc: ObjectLayer interface (L246) - the contract every storage backend implements for buckets, objects and versions.

nodes.label: Server Bootstrap
nodes.desc: serverMain (L746) validates endpoints, formats disks, then newObjectLayer (L1199) assembles the backend and registers it globally.

nodes.label: Server Pools
nodes.desc: erasureServerPools (L52) routes requests across pools: getPoolIdx (L637) picks where new objects land, GetDisks (L327) resolves disk sets.

nodes.label: Erasure Sets
nodes.desc: erasureSets (L51): newErasureSets (L352) builds each set of disks, GetLockers (L312) returns its dsync.NetLocker quorum.

nodes.label: Erasure Object Ops
nodes.desc: GetObjectNInfo (L203), PutObject (L1249), DeleteObject (L1885) coordinate reads/writes across the set with quorum checks.

nodes.label: Erasure Multipart
nodes.desc: NewMultipartUpload (L527) allocates upload IDs; CompleteMultipartUpload (L1096) assembles committed parts into the final object.

nodes.label: Healing
nodes.desc: HealObject (L1060) rebuilds missing or corrupt shards by reading surviving ones and re-encoding.

nodes.label: Reed-Solomon Codec
nodes.desc: Erasure struct (L35) holds data/parity counts; NewErasure (L42) validates parameters and lazily builds the reedsolomon encoder.

nodes.label: Shard Encoder
nodes.desc: Erasure.Encode (L69) streams object blocks into data and parity shards written to per-disk writers.

nodes.label: Shard Decoder
nodes.desc: Erasure.Decode (L239) reconstructs data from shards with a parallelReader; Erasure.Heal (L317) rewrites stale shards.

nodes.label: Erasure Metadata
nodes.desc: Quorum over FileInfo structs: ObjectToPartOffset (L268), findFileInfoInQuorum (L289) resolve metadata across disks.

nodes.label: Shard Placement
nodes.desc: hashOrder (L178) derives the per-object shard ordering so every disk knows which shard it owns.

nodes.label: Bitrot Protection
nodes.desc: Streaming checksum writer/reader protecting each shard against silent disk corruption.

nodes.label: FileInfo Types
nodes.desc: FileInfo and ErasureInfo messages exchanged with disks; newFileInfo (L388) seeds Distribution via hashOrder.

nodes.label: XL Storage
nodes.desc: xlStorage (L98) per-disk driver: ReadAll (L1829), CreateFile (L2092), WriteAll (L2305), CheckParts (L2399), RenameFile (L2997).

nodes.label: xl.meta v2
nodes.desc: xlMetaV2 (L901) binary metadata: version entries, part info, checksums, inline small-object data.

nodes.label: Namespace Locks
nodes.desc: newNSLock (L66) and nsLockMap (L85) serialize local bucket/object access before quorum locking.

nodes.label: DRWMutex
nodes.desc: DRWMutex (L113) takes distributed read/write locks (L158) on a quorum of lockers with continuous refresh.

nodes.label: dsync Core
nodes.desc: Quorum lock client: acquires N/2+1 grants across NetLocker endpoints before a lock is granted.

nodes.label: Lock REST Client
nodes.desc: newLockAPI (L101) builds the dsync.NetLocker stub for each peer endpoint.

nodes.label: Lock REST Server
nodes.desc: lockRESTServer (L30) serves LockHandler (L52), UnlockHandler (L65), RLockHandler (L74) as grid single-handlers.

nodes.label: Peer REST Server
nodes.desc: Serves intra-cluster requests from peers: bucket metadata reloads, lock listings, pool notifications.

nodes.label: Peer REST Client
nodes.desc: Calls peer servers over grid connections (L49, L82); getLocksRPC (L154) queries remote lock state.

nodes.label: Grid Messaging
nodes.desc: Connection manager multiplexing typed RPC streams between cluster nodes over a single TLS connection.

nodes.label: Config Subsystem
nodes.desc: SubSystems registry (L178) and dynamic config keys that every subsystem reads and watches.

nodes.label: SSE Crypto
nodes.desc: SSE-KMS implementation: retrieves per-object data encryption keys for server-side encryption.

nodes.label: KMS Client
nodes.desc: KMS abstraction talking to KES-backed key servers for root key material.

nodes.label: Event Targets
nodes.desc: Event types and target plumbing used by bucket notification configs to fan out S3 events.
